About.label: ABOUT MATHEUS SULINO
About.title: A curious mind. A hands-on approach.
About.intro: I'm Matheus Sulino, a Full-Stack Developer and Computer Science student at the Federal University of Tocantins (UFT). I live in Palmas, Tocantins, Brazil.
About.body: My interests span web applications, software systems and the decisions that connect an interface to its data. I use personal and academic projects to put theory into practice and develop my technical skills.
About.body2: VRAS CODE is my personal brand. Behind it is a continuous learning process: investigating a problem, understanding the trade-offs, writing code and checking what actually works.
About.principle1Body: Start with the context, the people and the constraints.
About.principle2Body: Connect interfaces, application logic and data with clear responsibilities.
About.principle3Body: Test the behavior, acknowledge limitations and keep improving.
